messages:
Tara (Sales): Quick check re: Helios Labs commit. They're asking for 12-week ramp with a 2x burst window for QA (hours limited) plus a one-time onboarding credit of 12%. Deal D-5033. Need signoff on credit + burst carve-out.

Ben (Solutions): From POC: 90 avg tokens/sec, 300 spikes. Suggested pool: min=2, target=4, max=7, GPUs: 4xA100 + 2xH100. Burst policy = qa-ramp-2x for first 30 days, hours 01:00-05:00 UTC. Pin fallback to A100-only variant.

Omar (Finance): 12% onboarding credit triggers VP review (>=12% per policy). Alternative: offer 8% onboarding + 4% spread over months 2-3 to avoid escalation. Need committed GPU-hours by month to run model. Also confirm billing monthly vs net-30 upfront.

Rae (EngOps): Note: us-east-1 H100 capacity is limited this quarter. We can support burst best-effort with fallback routing to A100s or to a different region. I'll open RED-3369 to track runbook and capacity anchoring. Recommend limiting burst nodes to +3 above target.

Zoe (Legal): For any onboarding credit >=10% include credit clawback clause on early termination. Also SOW addendum must state burst is best-effort and list fallback. I can draft a short addendum after Finance confirms commercial split.

Tara (Sales): Proposed to customer: 3-month commit, monthly invoices, onboarding credit = 8% month1 + 4% spread months 2-3, burst policy qa-ramp-2x limited to first 30 days with fallback to A100. Can Finance + Legal confirm?

Omar (Finance): OK to accept split (8% + 4%) without VP. I'll prepare a finance worksheet once Tara uploads GPU-hour forecast.

billing-bot: Reminder: Enter credits with code SALESPROC-D5033-ONB. Any credit >10% requires VP code.

Tara (Sales): Uploading forecast now and will submit deal-desk form after internal approvals. Thanks everyone.
